goal.en: Introduce yourself at your first team meeting and make a good impression.
goal.zh: 在第一次團隊會議上自我介紹，留下好印象。

background: small modern meeting room with a long wooden table, rolling chairs, a blank whiteboard, warm pendant lamps, coffee cups on the table, large window with a city view, morning light

intro.en: Tuesday morning. The whole team squeezes into the small meeting room, coffee in hand.
intro.zh: 星期二早上，整個團隊端著咖啡擠進小會議室。

intro.en: Ms. Wong stands at the end of the table and smiles at you.
intro.zh: 王經理站在長桌的一端，對你笑了笑。

lines.en: Everyone, this is Kai, our newest team member. Kai, would you like to say a few words?
lines.zh: 各位，這是我們的新成員凱。凱，要不要跟大家說幾句話？

choices.en: Sure. Let me briefly introduce myself. I'm Kai, and I'm from Taiwan.
choices.zh: 好的，我簡單自我介紹一下。我是凱，來自台灣。
choices.tip: Let me briefly introduce myself. 開場簡潔有禮，接著說名字和背景就好。

choices.en: Hello everyone, I am Kai, a newcomer. Please take care of me a lot.
choices.zh: 大家好，我是新人凱，請多多指教。

lines.en: Take care of you? Are you... feeling okay?

story.en: Daniel offers you a cough drop. Priya asks if you need a day off. You spend the meeting explaining that you're perfectly healthy.
story.zh: 丹尼爾遞給你一顆喉糖，普莉雅問你要不要請假。整場會議你都在解釋自己身體很健康。

fail.why: 「請多多指教」直譯成 Please take care of me. 聽起來像生病需要照顧。新人可以說 I'm looking forward to working with you all.。

choices.en: Um, sorry, my English is very poor and I know nothing, so please forgive all my mistakes.
choices.zh: 呃，不好意思，我英文很爛，什麼都不懂，請原諒我的各種錯誤。

lines.en: Kai, your English is fine. We hired you for a reason!
lines.zh: 凱，你的英文沒問題。我們錄取你是有原因的！

story.en: For the rest of the week, everyone speaks to you very slowly and very loudly, just in case.
story.zh: 接下來一整個星期，大家跟你說話都放得很慢、很大聲，以防萬一。

fail.why: 台灣習慣自謙，但在北美職場，一開口就說「我很爛、什麼都不懂」會讓人真的這樣相信。簡單介紹自己：Let me briefly introduce myself.。

lines.en: Welcome, Kai! I'm Daniel, I lead product design. So what brought you to Maple Bay?
lines.zh: 歡迎，凱！我是丹尼爾，負責產品設計。你怎麼會來楓灣？

choices.en: I came for a one-year language program, and I've always wanted to work abroad.
choices.zh: 我來參加一年的語言課程，而且我一直很想在國外工作。
choices.tip: I've always wanted to... 用現在完成式表示「一直以來都想」，說動機很自然。

choices.en: I have came here last month for study English and also for working holiday.
choices.zh: 我上個月來這裡讀英文，也是來打工度假。

lines.en: You have came... last month... Sorry, when did you arrive?
lines.zh: 你已經來……上個月……抱歉，你是什麼時候到的？

story.en: Daniel gets lost somewhere between "have came" and "last month." He decides to ask Ms. Wong about you later instead.
story.zh: 丹尼爾在「have came」和「last month」之間迷路了，決定之後再去問王經理你的事。

fail.why: 現在完成式是 have + 過去分詞（have come），而且不能和 last month 這種明確過去時間一起用。說 I came here last month to study English.。

choices.en: Your company's lights are so beautiful. I really like your designs very much.
choices.zh: 你們公司的燈好漂亮，我非常喜歡你們的設計。

lines.en: Oh, thanks! But... I meant, why Maple Bay?
lines.zh: 喔，謝謝！不過……我是問你為什麼來楓灣？

story.en: Daniel is flattered, but nobody learns anything about you. Two weeks later, someone still thinks you're from Japan.
story.zh: 丹尼爾聽了很開心，但大家對你一無所知。兩週後，還有人以為你是從日本來的。

fail.why: What brought you to...? 是問「你為什麼來」。稱讚可以留到後面，先回答問題：I came for a language program.。

lines.en: Hi, I'm Priya from marketing. What kind of work did you do back in Taiwan?
lines.zh: 嗨，我是行銷部的普莉雅。你在台灣做過什麼工作？

choices.en: I worked part-time at a design studio, mostly helping with product photos.
choices.zh: 我在一間設計工作室打工，主要幫忙拍產品照。
choices.tip: 說過去的經歷用過去式，再加一句具體內容，讓人更容易記住你。

choices.en: I was the best designer in my studio. Everyone said my photos were perfect.
choices.zh: 我是工作室裡最強的設計師，大家都說我的照片很完美。

lines.en: Wow... perfect, huh? Can't wait to see them.
lines.zh: 哇……完美喔？真期待看到呢。

story.en: The team now expects perfect photos. Your first assignment: shoot the entire new catalog by Friday.
story.zh: 大家現在都期待你拍出完美照片。你的第一個任務：星期五前拍完整本新型錄。

fail.why: 第一次見面就說自己「最強、最完美」聽起來很自大。具體描述做過什麼就好：I worked part-time at a design studio.。

choices.en: I am work at a design studio before, and I help them took the product photos.
choices.zh: 我之前在一間設計工作室工作，幫他們拍產品照。

lines.en: Sorry, do you work there now, or did you before?
lines.zh: 抱歉，你是現在在那裡工作，還是以前？

story.en: Priya thinks you still have another job. She quietly asks Ms. Wong if you're only working here part-time.
story.zh: 普莉雅以為你還有另一份工作，偷偷問王經理你是不是只在這裡兼職。

fail.why: 說過去的事要用過去式：I worked at a design studio.。I am work 是兩個動詞撞在一起，help them took 也要改成 help them take。

lines.en: Kai will be helping Priya with the new café campaign. Any questions for the team, Kai?
lines.zh: 凱會協助普莉雅做新的咖啡廳企劃。凱，有什麼想問大家的嗎？

choices.en: Just one. What's the best way to reach everyone, email or the team chat?
choices.zh: 只有一個。聯絡大家最好用什麼方式，email 還是團隊聊天群組？
choices.tip: 會議上問實用的問題，例如溝通管道，顯示你想快速融入團隊。

choices.en: No questions. I will just do whatever the boss tells me to do.
choices.zh: 沒有問題。老闆叫我做什麼，我就做什麼。

lines.en: Oh... Kai, we like ideas here, not just following orders.
lines.zh: 喔……凱，我們這裡重視想法，不只是聽命令。

story.en: The team decides you're very quiet. For the next month, nobody thinks to ask for your opinion.
story.zh: 大家認定你很安靜。接下來一個月，沒有人想到要問你的意見。

fail.why: 在台灣表示服從是禮貌，但北美職場期待新人也有想法。會議上問一個實際的問題，例如 What's the best way to reach everyone?。

choices.en: Yes! Does anyone know a good place near here to buy cheap furniture for my room?
choices.zh: 有！有人知道這附近哪裡可以買便宜家具嗎？我房間要用。

lines.en: Uh... maybe ask Sam after the meeting?

story.en: Ten minutes of sofa talk later, the meeting runs over. Ms. Wong gives you a long, patient look.
story.zh: 大家聊沙發聊了十分鐘，會議超時了。王經理用耐心又意味深長的眼神看了你一眼。

fail.why: 團隊會議上的提問要和工作相關。私人問題留到會後問同事，會議上可以問 What's the best way to reach everyone?。

lines.en: Great question. Team chat for quick things, email for clients. Anything else you'd like to add?
lines.zh: 好問題。小事用團隊聊天群組，客戶的事用 email。還有什麼想補充的嗎？

choices.en: Just that I'm looking forward to working with you all. Thanks for having me.
choices.zh: 只想說，我很期待和大家一起工作。謝謝大家。
choices.tip: I'm looking forward to + V-ing，to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞。

choices.en: Only that I'm looking forward to work with you all. Thank you all so much.
choices.zh: 只想說，我很期待和大家一起工作。非常謝謝大家。

lines.en: Looking forward to... work? Ha, sorry, my grammar alarm just went off.
lines.zh: 期待……work？哈，抱歉，我的文法警報響了。

story.en: Nobody really minds. But the next morning, you find a sticky note on your desk from Daniel that just says "working :)"
story.zh: 其實沒人介意。但隔天早上，你在桌上發現丹尼爾留的便利貼，上面只寫著「working :)」。

fail.why: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面要接名詞或 V-ing：I'm looking forward to working with you.。

choices.en: I hope everyone can teach me more. I will work very hard. Add oil!
choices.zh: 希望大家多多教我，我會很努力。加油！

lines.en: Add oil? To what, the coffee machine?
lines.zh: 加油？加到哪裡，咖啡機嗎？

story.en: "Add oil" becomes the team's new catchphrase. Unfortunately, nobody remembers anything else you said.
story.zh: 「Add oil」成了團隊的新口頭禪。可惜，沒人記得你說的其他內容。

fail.why: 「加油」直譯成 Add oil 很多人聽不懂。想為自己打氣，可以說 I'll do my best.；結尾說 I'm looking forward to working with you all. 最得體。

lines.en: Thanks, Kai. Welcome aboard. Okay, everyone, let's get started.
lines.zh: 謝謝你，凱，歡迎加入。好，各位，我們開始吧。

lines.en: Let's grab coffee later and talk about the café campaign!
lines.zh: 晚點一起喝杯咖啡，聊聊咖啡廳企劃吧！

story.en: Your introduction is short, clear, and friendly. By lunch, three people have stopped by your desk to say hi.
story.zh: 你的自我介紹簡短、清楚又親切。到中午，已經有三個人到你座位打招呼。

notes.explain: 正式場合自我介紹的開場句，briefly 讓大家知道你不會講太久。之後說名字、背景、一句期待就夠了。

example.en: Let me briefly introduce myself. I'm Kai, and I'm new to the design team.
example.zh: 我簡單自我介紹一下，我是凱，設計團隊的新成員。

notes.en: I'm looking forward to working with you.
notes.zh: 我很期待和你們一起工作。
notes.explain: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面要接名詞或動名詞 V-ing，不是原形動詞。

example.en: I'm looking forward to meeting our clients.

notes.explain: 現在完成式表示從過去持續到現在的心願。注意現在完成式不能和 last month、yesterday 這類明確過去時間連用。

example.en: I've always wanted to live by the sea.

notes.explain: 英文的 take care of me 是「照顧我」，聽起來像生病了。新人可以說 I'm happy to be here. 或 I'm looking forward to working with you.。

example.en: I'm new here, so I'm happy to learn from all of you.
example.zh: 我是新人，很樂意向大家學習。

notes.explain: 台灣習慣自謙說「我英文很爛、什麼都不懂」，但在北美職場，過度謙虛會讓人以為你真的不行。簡單說出背景和期待就好。

example.en: I'm still learning, but I'm excited to contribute.
example.zh: 我還在學習，但很期待能有所貢獻。
